resources.string: Forward WhatsApp notifications to Spark, even when the app is closed. Spark never sends WhatsApp messages.
Paste the token from Spark → Settings → WhatsApp companion
Notification access is off. Tap “Open notification access”, find Spark Companion, and allow it.
Add the backend URL and device token first.
Spark sees WhatsApp message titles and text from notifications. It does not read chat history, and it cannot send messages. You can revoke access in Android Settings or revoke this device in Spark.
